questions.question_text: Analyze how Ogden Nash subverts heroic tropes in 'The Tale of Custard the Dragon'.
questions.correct_answer: The outwardly brave pets (Ink, Blink, Mustard) panic and flee from a pirate, while the timid dragon (Custard) fearlessly devours the intruder.
questions.explanation: Nash contrasts empty boasting with actual crisis heroism, proving true courage lies in action rather than bravado.
